result.description:
MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Employment Type: Permanent Full Time; 38 hours per week
Position Classification: Registered Nurse
Remuneration: $79,368 - $111,427 per annum + Superannuation
Located in: Royal Prince Alfred Hospital
Requisition ID: REQ657341

 
 

In Sydney Local Health District our vision is Excellence in health and healthcare for all. You will be working in an innovative district that celebrates and invests in the ideas of staff, values people and offers life-long careers. Join the team at one of the leading public health organisations in Australia!

 
 

About the Role

You will be working at Royal Prince Alfred Hospital (RPAH). It is one of the nation's most respected hospitals, with a distinguished history of serving the health needs of local, statewide, national and international communities. Our facilities and services are world class and our staff are dedicated, innovative and caring.

The Registered Nurse is responsible for the provision of patient centred, evidence informed nursing care that promotes identified health outcomes. The Registered Nurse will assess, plan, implement and evaluate nursing care in collaboration with individuals and the multidisciplinary healthcare team.

7 West 1 is a 24-bed, high acuity unit specialising in the care of patients undergoing stem cell transplants, CAR T-cell therapy, and intensive chemotherapy. Our team provides advanced, evidence-based nursing for individuals with complex hematologic conditions, combining clinical expertise with compassionate, patient centred support throughout the treatment journey.
 
For more information, please view the Position Description.

Ideal Candidate

Current nursing registration with the Nursing and Midwifery Board of Australia (AHPRA).

Effective interpersonal skills, excellent written and verbal communication skills within a multidisciplinary team.

Experience in oncology, critical care or other specialty units preferred.

Experience in haematology or stem cell transplant nursing is desirable but not essential.

Recent acute nursing-hospital experience and Australian working rights essential.

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 

 

Benefits

Allocated Day Off (ADO) each month, paid parental leave and annual leave loading.

Opportunity for extra tax savings through Salary Packaging and Novated Leasing. For more information visit SalaryPackagingPlus.

Access to free courses, qualifications and coaching via Sydney Education.

Access to confidential EAP counselling for staff and their families.

Because we care about your health: Free annual influenza vaccination, discounted Fitness Passport membership, and free telehealth nutrition and wellness resources from qualified professionals.

For more information about other benefits, please visit SLHD Benefits.

This recruitment may be used to create a talent pool for similar future roles (ongoing or temporary) that may arise over the next 18 months.

Working for Sydney Local Health District - NSW Health 

This is a Category A position. To be employed by NSW Health you are required to provide evidence of vaccination to comply with the NSW Health Occupational Assessment, Screening & Vaccination against Specified Infectious Diseases Policy (PD2026_004).

 
SLHD is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing a working environment that embraces and values diversity and inclusion. Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people and people with disability are encouraged to apply for all internal and externally advertised positions. result.description:
Experienced Restaurant Manager NEEDED

Choji Yakiniku Pty Ltd 

Hanasuki is a premium Japanese restaurant in Chatswood specialising in authentic shabu shabu and sukiyaki dining experiences. The restaurant focuses on high quality Japanese cuisine prepared with premium ingredients, including Japanese sourced Wagyu beef, fresh seafood and seasonal vegetables. Signature broths are carefully crafted using traditional Japanese dashi, while all meats and vegetables are precisely sliced to enhance their flavour and texture. In addition to its signature hot pot offerings, the restaurant provides à la carte dishes, banquet menus and private dining experiences, delivering an authentic Japanese dining experience in a modern and welcoming environment for both individual diners and groups. More information can be found on our website: https://www.hanasuki.com.au/

This is a full-time opportunity for an enthusiastic, hardworking and reliable person. Opportunities are also available for staff with sommelier experience and knowledge.  

Location: Chatswood, NSW

Duties and Key Responsibilities:

•	Develops and designs menus in collaboration with chefs.
•	Plans, coordinates, and oversees special functions and events.
•	Manages the procurement and pricing of goods in line with budget requirements.
•	Maintains accurate records of stock, purchases, and financial transactions.
•	Ensures that dining and food service areas meet health, safety, and presentation standards.
•	Engages with customers to evaluate their satisfaction with food quality and service.
•	Recruits, trains, and supervises front-of-house and kitchen staff.
•	May handle reservations, welcome guests, and assist with order taking as needed.
•	Oversees and manages the overall operations of the restaurant to ensure efficient dining and catering services.
Experience 
Either:
•	At least 2 years of relevant work experience preferred
•	Holds at least a AQF Associate Degree, Advanced Diploma or Diploma or has 3 years of relevant experience to substitute. 

Skills required:

•	Attention to detail;
•	Ability to work under pressure;
•	Reliable and motivated;
•	Good team player;
•	Communication Skills; 
•	Must possess excellent communication, management and leadership skills, and interpersonal skills.

Annual salary package: $80,000.00  - $90,000.00 per annum plus superannuation

You must be an Australian citizen or permanent resident to apply.
